title: What is a poem?
author: Dalayla
content:
What is a Poem if it does not breathe
If it does not feel pain if it Cannot grieve
What is a Poem if it hasn't felt
If it cannot care if it took no courage to share
What is a Poem if it has no memory, no story, no tears
Poetry cannot be created in an instant
It's a portrait of years of life that's been lived
And tear stains cheeks.

It's the scent of rain and rustling leaves
It's late night laughter in a Kitchen Floor
The light in the hall spilling out of the door
The feeling of fingers laced in your own
The voice of someone you love on the other side of the phone
So when you ask me how I Feel . . .

I feel betrayed but I do not feel threatened in the least
A voice wants a story well
All it can do is speak so take it if you like
But if you think that's Poetry you're terribly wrong
Take the life from the Poem & the whole Poem is gone

title: A Red, Red Rose
author: Robert Burns
content:
O my Luve is like a red, red rose,
That’s newly sprung in June;
O my Luve is like the melody,
That’s sweetly play’d in tune.

As fair art thou, my bonnie lass,
So deep in luve am I;
And I will luve thee still, my dear,
Till a’ the seas gang dry.

title: The Road Not Taken
author: Robert Frost
content:
Two roads diverged in a yellow wood,
And sorry I could not travel both
And be one traveler, long I stood
And looked down one as far as I could
To where it bent in the undergrowth;

Then took the other, as just as fair,
And having perhaps the better claim,
Because it was grassy and wanted wear;
Though as for that the passing there
Had worn them really about the same.

title: Sonnet 18
author: William Shakespeare
content:
Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
Thou art more lovely and more temperate:
Rough winds do shake the darling buds of May,
And summer's lease hath all too short a date:

Sometime too hot the eye of heaven shines,
And often is his gold complexion dimm'd;
And every fair from fair sometime declines,
By chance or nature's changing course untrimm'd.
